compiled_state.title: GREEN: Implement plugins/dso/scripts/migrate-story-pr-bases.sh
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
Implement plugins/dso/scripts/migrate-story-pr-bases.sh to make all tests in tests/scripts/test-migrate-story-pr-bases.sh pass (GREEN gate).

Implementation requirements:
1. Use resolve-session-branch.sh (via `bash "$_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/resolve-session-branch.sh"`) to resolve the session branch; fail fast if unresolvable
2. List open story/* PRs targeting main: `gh pr list --json number,headRefName,baseRefName --state open | jq ...`
3. For each PR with baseRefName == 'main' and headRefName matching 'story/*': PATCH base to session branch via `gh api PATCH /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{n} -f base=<session-branch>`
4. Trigger fresh per-branch-review: `gh workflow run per-branch-review.yml --ref <story-branch>`
5. Invalidate cached review-status: delete or reset the cached review-status artifact marker for the PR (document the TrackerDefenseStore interaction — no defense records should be preserved across base migration since the diff context changes)
6. Idempotent: skip PRs already targeting the session branch; produce no duplicate API calls on re-run
7. Support GH_PR_LIST_OVERRIDE / GH_API_PATCH_OVERRIDE / GH_WORKFLOW_RUN_OVERRIDE env vars for test isolation
8. set -euo pipefail; use mktemp for any temp files; never hardcode /tmp paths
9. Print INFO/WARN/ERROR lines to stderr; print migrated PR numbers to stdout

TrackerDefenseStore documentation: After base migration, any DEFENSE_RECORD entries tied to the old base (main) diff context are stale. The script should log a WARN noting that operators should clear TrackerDefenseStore records for migrated PRs using review-defense-store.sh reset --pr <n> if cycle-N defenses exist for those PRs.
